name: oucs
description: Open Universal Container for Sound — JavaScript/WASM bindings

scripts.build:wasm: emcc ../../src/*.c -I../../include -O2 -s WASM=1 -s EXPORTED_RUNTIME_METHODS=['ccall','cwrap','getValue','setValue'] -s EXPORTED_FUNCTIONS=['_oucs_writer_create','_oucs_writer_add_song_mem','_oucs_writer_finalize','_oucs_writer_free','_oucs_reader_open','_oucs_reader_song_count','_oucs_reader_extract_song_mem','_oucs_reader_free','_oucs_stream_open','_oucs_stream_read_chunk','_oucs_stream_seek','_oucs_stream_seek_chapter','_oucs_stream_tell','_oucs_stream_free','_oucs_version','_oucs_strerror','_malloc','_free'] -s ALLOW_MEMORY_GROWTH=1 -s MODULARIZE=1 -s EXPORT_NAME=OucsModule -lm -o dist/oucs.js
